# Iris

Source: https://github.com/SirMallard/Iris/tree/1043909bccf0c532811d60f915a1ce1ec28db867

The lib sources are vendored without code changes (trailing whitespace normalized) under the MIT license in LICENSE.txt. Bundle.lua is generated by tools/build_iris.py: it packages those modules with a local module tree and isolated require/script environments, without downloading code at runtime or creating ModuleScript instances. The demo is available as upstream API but is never connected/rendered by Legit.
